title: Integrate AI Chat Component into Dashboard Homepage
description: Render the new AI chat component within the main dashboard homepage (`app/dashboard/page.tsx`) without disrupting existing layout.
details:
- Import the `AIChat` component into `app/dashboard/page.tsx`.
- Place the chat UI in an appropriate section of the dashboard, ensuring it coexists with existing widgets and content.
- Adjust layout or grid as needed to accommodate the new component while maintaining responsiveness and visual consistency.
test_strategy: Verify visually and with tests that the chat UI appears on the dashboard homepage, does not overlap or break existing content, and is responsive on different screen sizes.

title: Write Component Tests for AI Chat UI
description: Develop component-level tests for the AI chat UI to ensure correct rendering, message handling, and mocked AI responses.
details:
- Use Jest and React Testing Library to write tests for the `AIChat` component.
- Test cases should include: initial render, user message submission, AI response appearance, scroll behavior, and accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA labels).
- Optionally, create a Storybook story for isolated UI testing and documentation.
test_strategy: Run all tests locally and in CI to ensure the chat UI behaves as expected. Check for accessibility violations using axe or similar tools.

title: Create AI Chat Component
description: Develop a reusable AI chat UI component encapsulating chat logic and UI, using shadcn/ui components and Tailwind CSS.
details:
- Create a new file at `components/chat/ai-chat.tsx` and mark it as a client component with the 'use client' directive.
- Use shadcn/ui's `Card` for the chat container, `ScrollArea` for the message list, `Input` for user entry, and `Button` for sending messages.
- Define a message data structure (e.g., `{ id: string, role: 'user' | 'ai', content: string }`).
- Style the component to match the dashboard's theme and ensure responsiveness and accessibility.
- Encapsulate all chat logic and state within this component.
test_strategy: Write unit tests with React Testing Library to verify initial rendering, correct use of shadcn/ui components, and accessibility (labels, keyboard navigation).

title: Implement Chat State Management and Mocked AI Response
description: Add state management for messages and user input, and simulate AI responses within the chat component.
details:
- Use React's `useState` to manage an array of messages and the current input value.
- Implement a `handleSubmit` function to add the user's message to the message array.
- Simulate an AI response by adding a mocked reply after a short delay (e.g., 1 second) when the user sends a message.
- Ensure the message list scrolls to the latest message automatically using `useEffect` and refs.
test_strategy: Test that submitting input adds a user message, triggers a mocked AI response, and that the scroll area updates to show the latest message. Use Jest and React Testing Library for interaction tests.
